description: Search Sophia Commons for anthroposophical organizations: Waldorf schools, biodynamic farms, Camphill communities, The Christian Community, clinics, eurythmy, study groups and more. Combine a free-text query with category, country and city filters.

category.description: waldorf = Waldorf/Steiner schools and kindergartens; biodynamic = biodynamic and Demeter farms; christian_community = The Christian Community congregations; camphill = Camphill communities; community = other intentional communities; eurythmy = eurythmy and the arts; medicine = anthroposophic medicine; societies = Anthroposophical Society branches and study groups; eldercare = care homes; online = online resources; social_media = groups and channels; science = Goethean science

country.description: Country name in English, e.g. "Germany", "United States", "New Zealand"

limit.description: How many results to return (default 20, max 50)

query.description: Words to look for in the name or description, e.g. "kindergarten", "Demeter dairy", "Goetheanum"

name: search_directory
title: Search the directory
